title: Changing a tool safely
summary: Change one typed descriptor, follow its derived relationships, and verify every generated projection.
audience: A contributor adding a tool operation or changing the input, result, receipt, error, or writer policy of an existing one.

claims.text: The operation descriptor is the machine authority for its name, input, result, receipt, error, writer policy, and lifecycle relation. Change that boundary before adapting handlers or protocol registration.

Callers should infer an operation's input, result, receipt, error, and writer policy from the descriptor. If a change requires callers to repeat those type arguments or returns a union of every operation, the generic boundary has widened.
Regenerate and compare the compound JSON Schema whenever an Effect contract changes. The checked-in digest is consumed by the Python ActiveGraph bridge before its first tool call.

Regenerate this manifest and revalidate only guides that cite changed facts. A prose-agent run is traceable execution, while the descriptor, source signature, and reviewed evidence remain the factual support.
